record.field: Medical Center
Manage Medical Center roles, clinical appointments, and staff permissions
Medical Center - Doctor
Doctor Allowed Actions: Start/End consultations, clinical notes, diagnosis, prescriptions, follow-up bookings, and patient medical history
Medical Center - Doctor Manager (Head of Doctors)
Head of Doctors: Can supervise and view all appointments, clinical notes, and schedules of doctors in their department or reporting to them
Medical Center - Nurse
Nurse Allowed Actions: Patient vitals triage (BP, temp, pulse, SpO2, weight, height, BMI, blood sugar), nurse notes, and ready-for-doctor status
Medical Center - Nurse Manager (Head Nurse)
Head Nurse: Can supervise and view all triage assessments and vitals queues of nurses in their department or reporting to them
Medical Center - Receptionist
Receptionist Allowed Actions: Day-before confirmation calls, confirm bookings, reschedule appointment date & doctor, and patient arrival check-in
Medical Center - Receptionist Manager (Head Receptionist)
Head Receptionist: Can oversee all front-desk operations, waiting room check-ins, confirmation calls, and rescheduling across the clinic
Medical Center - Sales Employee
Sales Employee Allowed Actions: CRM lead follow-up, call logging, book appointments from leads, choose doctor and service, finish lead, sales commission tracking
Medical Center - Sales Manager (Head of Sales)
Head of Sales: Can view and manage all CRM leads, calls, performance, and booked appointments of sales employees in their team or reporting to them
Medical Center - HR Manager
HR Manager: Staff management, scheduling, and leave management
Medical Center - Security Rules Manager
Administrator who can review and configure role-based security rules
